task.description: TEST-RUNNER's rework1 full-suite gate found a genuine regression this branch caused: this run added `role_claims_synced_at` to `Letflow.Identity.User` (§2.2's new field), and `lib/letflow/identity_migration.ex`'s `copy_users/2` (~line 155) has no `select:` restriction, so it now pulls that new field into a query against the LEGACY, frozen `public.users` table (which was never migrated to carry that column), causing `Postgrex.Error ... undefined_column` -- 7 test failures in test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs. Fix: add the same kind of explicit `select:` restriction `copy_groups/2` (same module) already carries from an earlier REQ-074 column-addition hazard of this identical class -- read copy_groups/2's existing guard first and mirror its exact shape/pattern for copy_users/2, restricting the query to only the legacy columns that actually exist in public.users. Run `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` and `mix test test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs` and quote real output confirming all pass. Also re-run the previously-regressed/REQ-378 test files (test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/api_pipeline_integration_test.exs test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs test/letflow/plugs/iss0736_oidc_live_revocation_test.exs) to confirm no new regression. Run everything in the foreground -- no background Monitor waiting.
acceptance_criteria: copy_users/2 fixed to mirror copy_groups/2's existing select-restriction pattern for this exact hazard class
